Kyle's Bike Shop Thursday Night Ride

Orlando, FL · Colonialtown · Road

No-drop

Kyle's Bike Shop Thursday Night Ride is a road group ride in Orlando, FL. It rolls every Thursday at 7:00 pm from Kyle's Bike Shop parking lot. About 30–36 miles, a 19+, B 16–19, C/D under 16 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @kylesbikeshop the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Kyle's Bike Shop Thursday Night Ride group ride

Long-running Orlando shop ride. Four rotating routes of roughly 30 to 36 miles, split into A through D groups, with a mid-ride stop. Lights and helmets required. Show up 30 minutes early.
